costs.note: Threefold tuition fee CHF 2190 per semester, CHF 4,380 a year (foreign students); with compulsory semester fees CHF 4,528 a year.

living.note: ETH's approximate individual living costs for international students: CHF 22,100 a year (rent, meals, transport, health insurance, personal expenses).

admissions.threshold: Biochemistry – Chemical Biology: IB 38 out of 42 (without bonus points) with HL Mathematics, HL physics, chemistry or biology, and HL language A, for admission without an entrance examination (2026/27 rules); otherwise the Reduced Entrance Examination.

Biochemistry – Chemical Biology: AAA, three A-Levels in mathematics, physics/chemistry/biology and a language at minimum grade A each, plus further subjects, for admission without an entrance examination (2026/27 rules); otherwise the Reduced Entrance Examination.
